name: NEET Chemistry
marking: +4 for correct, −1 for wrong, 0 for unattempted
style: NCERT Class 11 and 12 chemistry, NCERT facts and reactions. Mix physical-chemistry numericals, inorganic facts and trends, and organic reactions and named reagents; include assertion-reason, statement I/II and match-the-column items, as recent NEET papers do.
weightage: NTA does not publish chapter weightage. Spread questions roughly evenly over physical, inorganic and organic chemistry, all chapters in the pool.
difficulty: Mixed = 30% easy, 50% medium, 20% hard. 1 = direct NCERT line, 3 = one-step numerical or two facts combined, 5 = multi-step numerical or reaction sequence.
source_note: Pattern (45 chemistry MCQs of 180, 180 min total, +4/−1, no optional Section B since 2025) is from the NTA NEET (UG) information bulletin at neet.nta.nic.in. Chapter list follows the NCERT 2026-27 chemistry textbooks at ncert.nic.in. Both sites refused automated fetches on 2026-11-23, so re-check against the latest bulletin before relying on it.
